prompt:
Write a CommonJS JavaScript module. Export exactly the requested function with module.exports = functionName. Use no imports, dependencies, filesystem or network. Return only one fenced javascript code block, with no explanation.

Implement mergePatch(target, patch) according to JSON Merge Patch (RFC 7396). If patch is not a non-null non-array object, return a deep copy of patch. Otherwise start from a deep copy of target if it is such an object, else {}. For each patch key, null deletes that key; every other value recursively applies mergePatch to that property. Arrays are replaced, not merged. Inputs are JSON values. Do not mutate or share mutable arrays/objects with either input.
